questions.question: Which of the following algorithms is a variant of Best-First Search?
What is the main idea behind Best-First Search?

answers.a: To systematically explore all possible paths in a graph
answers.b: To always choose the shortest path to the goal node
answers.c: To use heuristics to prioritize nodes closer to the goal
answers.d: To randomly choose a path until the goal node is reached

questions.question: Which of the following is a heuristic used in Best-First Search?

answers.a: Depth of the node in the search tree
answers.b: Cost of the path from start node to current node
answers.c: Estimated cost from the current node to the goal node
answers.d: Number of neighbors of the current node

questions.question: What is the main advantage of Best-First Search over Breadth-First Search?

answers.a: Guaranteed to find the optimal solution
answers.d: Faster exploration by focusing on promising nodes

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a part of Best-First Search?
What is the primary goal of Best-First Search?

answers.a: To find the shortest path from start to end node
answers.c: To find the most efficient path to the goal using heuristics
answers.d: To avoid revisiting previously explored nodes
